digest.component_or_area: LLM provider runner module size gate
propositions: The test test_runner_regains_real_headroom_under_the_cap turns RED because runner.py lands at 713 LOC after rebasing, above the attested <700 target.
This is not a split regression: 2682's split still removes 85 lines, but main's runner.py baseline grew to 798 so replaying the split now exceeds 700.

runner.py cannot be forced under 700 without moving monkeypatch seams (_import_pydantic_ai, _pai_check_config, _check_tool_capability/_TOOL_CAPABILITY_CHECKED) pinned across ~9 test files, contradicting 2682's zero-test-edit criterion.
A re-export shim to hit ~698 mechanically is forbidden by the module-size policy against gaming the number.
runner.py on origin/main sits at 798 against an 800 cap, leaving main itself two lines from a build break.
A decision must be recorded choosing among proper seam extraction, re-deriving the target against current main, or pushing back on main's runner.py growth.
